name: Imasaka Yue
source: Yue is a first-year student in a nursing school. She is friends with [url=/c161796]Inaho Shin[/url] and was classmates with him at Sumisora High School. She visits the Cubic Café from time to time to catch up with Shin. She lovingly calls Shin's dog "Ken," seemingly unaware of its origin.
translation: Yue is a first-year student in a nursing school. She is friends with [url=/c161796]Inaho Shin[/url] and was classmates with him at Sumisora High School. She visits the Cubic Café from time to time to catch up with Shin. She lovingly calls Shin's dog "Ken," seemingly unaware of its origin.
